diagnosis.inference: Generating a nearly occluded room from a door-only first frame plus prose encourages invented interior/actor content; endpoint and identity control should precede another paid run.

method.recommended: Correct and compare all 14 full-resolution stills first. Then use a video mode verified to accept both exact first and last frames for each narrative pair. Keep cast/props constrained in those stills; keep extra identity references when supported. Keep ambient loops separate, using the proven single-image locked-camera workflow.
method.doNotAssume: First/last-frame support does not guarantee identity, intermediate anatomy or geometric continuity. Models can morph unrelated endpoints; inspect endpoints and intermediate frames before accepting.
method.fallbackIfNoVerifiedTailControl: Do not use Hailuo-2.3 Fast first-frame-only to invent the opening interior. Use deterministic layered door/camera composition with the exact approved interior, or select a separately verified first/last-frame mode after price and authorization confirmation.
method.sourceQuality: Use corrected original high-resolution single images, not storyboard contact-sheet crops, browser screenshots or the bad pilot.
